lead.h: "Narrative" is the business word of the year. Investors: what we invest in is a feeling
p: The word "narrative" appears in this quarter's pitch decks six times as often as last year. Several investors say the product details can be filled in by an assistant: "What we look at is whether the founder has the feeling."
A product manager who asked not to be named says she has not opened a requirements document in three weeks.
